sections.voiceover: National Geographic writer Nina Strochlic reported that his wife, Bess, drove his stardom.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait photograph of Bess and Harry Houdini together.
sections.animation_cue: Slow push in on the photograph.

sections.voiceover: Every page of Harry Houdini's first travel diary from 1897 to 1899 is now public. These deciphered notes chart his rise to international stardom. The collection reveals dime-store vaudeville struggles.
sections.visual_cue: Detailed shot of handwritten diary pages with annotations by John Cox.

sections.voiceover: Dr. Bruce Averbook holds this diary from 1897 in his collection.
